notes: Phone for the Teen Services Librarian: 760-839-4283 (listed on the page with a call-to-ask-questions note). Page lists no age range or cost.
name: Escondido Library Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Plan teen programs, keep the teen area welcoming, suggest books for the teen collection, and speak up for teens. The group meets monthly.
who_can_apply: Local teens. The page does not give an age range or grade rule.
duration: 2026-2027 school year; meetings on the second Monday of each month, 4:30 to 5:30 p.m.
deadline_text: The library is accepting new members for the 2026-2027 school year. No deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Get the Teen Advisory Board form from the page as a PDF. You can also pick one up at the Youth Services Desk on the 2nd floor. Email the finished form to teens@escondidolibrary.org (shown on the page).
